OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Ourbit‘s XP Arena Is Coming
3 Ways to Play, 3 Prize Pools, Up to 3,000,000 USDT
Play 1: Scratch for XP
Complete tasks for Loot Cards and stack XP to share 50,000 USDT every 7 days. Every card also has a chance to reveal random rewards.
Play 2: Collect Tickets, Win Big
Complete tasks for Golden Tickets. Each winning ticket pays 50 USDT, and wins stack.
Play 3: Team Up and Climb the Ranks
Team up with friends and compete on Futures trading volume to unlock up to 2,500,000 USDT in prizes.
Starts Dec 2, 04:00 (UTC)!
